title: Google’s most sophisticated foldable: Pixel 11 Pro Fold
excerpt: Pixel 11 Pro Fold is our latest foldable with a thinner and lighter design, a new main camera, and enhanced intelligence tools.
content_html:
Aug 12, 2026

|

Introducing Pixel 11 Pro Fold, our latest foldable with a thinner and lighter design, brand-new main camera, added durability inside and out, and enhanced intelligence tools.

Justin Savich

Group Product Manager

Pixel 11 Pro Fold is here, and it’s our most sophisticated foldable yet. With a fresh and durable design, stunning (and helpful) new camera visor with HiLight, and unique features that help you throughout your day, this phone is next-level.

Compact design and enhancements

Pixel 11 Pro Fold is almost 10% lighter and about 1mm thinner than Pixel 10 Pro Fold, so it’s more comfortable to hold in your hand and in your pocket. 1 With even thinner bezels than before for a sleek look, the new Pro Fold comes in our classic Obsidian and brand-new Olive for a pop of color.

Pixel 11 Pro Fold gets an addition to its iconic camera bar: HiLight. It uses LED lights built around the camera’s flash to give you timely, glanceable information. Use HiLight to get color-coded glows for incoming calls from your favorite contacts, or when you’re talking to Gemini hands-free. Over time, you’ll see more capabilities added to HiLight — like message notifications from your favorite contacts.

A phone built to last

Pixel 11 Pro Fold maintains the same high standard we set last year for durability, with an impressive IP68 dust and water protection rating 2 — but we didn’t stop there.

The new glass fiber composite back cover is designed to be nearly impossible to crack. 3 Paired with a new gearless hinge that protects the inner display and a new Super Actua outer display made of ultra-strong ceramic cover glass, this phone is three times more durable than last year’s device, and it’s our most durable Pixel Fold yet. 4

Plus, Pixel 11 Pro Fold has improved crease performance, thanks to the new hinge’s larger bend radius and thicker glass layer on the inner display. And both displays are 20% brighter than last year at 3600 nits. 5

You’ll notice we upgraded charging speeds for Pixel 11 Pro Fold, too. Plug in and get 50% charged in about 30 minutes with 30W wired charging. 6 Or charge wirelessly 20% faster than our last generation Fold phone with up to 25W Qi2.2 built-in. 7 Beyond charging, Pixel 11 Pro Fold has over 24 hours of battery life, so you can confidently get through the day. 8

New features for the big screen

Powered by our new custom Tensor G6 chip and equipped with 16GB of RAM, Pixel 11 Pro Fold delivers smooth, speedy performance and is designed for Gemini Intelligence. 9

The dual screens on Pixel 11 Pro Fold are ideal for real-time translation, especially with our new sign-to-text feature. Developed in partnership with the Deaf community, it lets signers express themselves in Live Transcribe and Gboard in their native language. 10 Pixel 11 Pro Fold’s hands-free form factor makes setting up for signing easy, and can be used with both one-handed and two-handed signing. Sign American Sign Language to the front camera and translations will appear on the outer display.

And bubbles have been optimized for Fold to make multitasking easy. Turn any app into a bubble and you'll be able to see it on the bottom right corner of your screen when unfolded for quick and easy access.

Foldable-exclusive features you know and love are here to stay, like Drag and Drop, Split Screen, Instant View, and two new animations for Made You Look. Plus, Pixel 11 Pro Fold is equipped with the same helpful features as the rest of the Pixel 11 lineup, including proactive assistance 11 , and improved Circle to Search integration with Pixel Camera. 12

A camera for moments you can’t retake

From detailed landscape shots to extreme close-ups, you’ll get crisp, beautiful images every time thanks to a new 48MP main camera and telephoto camera with up to 30x Super Zoom. New features for the Pixel 11 series like Magic Capture and Camera Looks allow you to elevate and personalize your photos by capturing the perfect moment when your subject is in motion and providing customizable Looks that bring your unique vision to life.

Order Pixel 11 Pro Fold today

Pixel 11 Pro Fold is available for pre-order today and hits shelves on August 20. And be sure to check out our new Pixel 11 Pro Fold case with an integrated hinge cover for added protection.

Visit the Google Store for more information on availability and product updates.

content_html_zh:
Aug 12, 2026

|

隆重推出 Pixel 11 Pro Fold，这是我们最新的可折叠手机，具有更薄、更轻的设计、全新的主摄像头、增强的内外耐用性以及增强的智能工具。

贾斯汀·萨维奇

集团产品经理

Pixel 11 Pro Fold 现已上市，它是我们迄今为止最先进的可折叠手机。 这款手机采用新颖耐用的设计、令人惊叹（且实用）的 HiLight 新型相机遮光罩，以及可帮助您一整天的独特功能，堪称全新水平。

紧凑的设计和增强功能

Pixel 11 Pro Fold 比 Pixel 10 Pro Fold 轻了近 10%，薄了约 1 毫米，因此握在手中和口袋中都更加舒适。 1 新款 Pro Fold 的边框比以前更薄，外观时尚，采用经典黑曜石色和全新橄榄色，打造流行色彩。

Pixel 11 Pro Fold 增加了标志性相机栏：HiLight。 它使用相机闪光灯周围内置的 LED 灯，为您提供及时、一目了然的信息。 使用 HiLight 为您最喜爱的联系人的来电或与 Gemini 免提通话时获取颜色编码的发光效果。 随着时间的推移，您将看到 HiLight 中添加更多功能，例如来自您最喜爱的联系人的消息通知。

经久耐用的手机

Pixel 11 Pro Fold 保持了我们去年设定的耐用性高标准，具有令人印象深刻的 IP68 防尘防水等级 2，但我们并没有就此止步。

新型玻璃纤维复合材料后盖的设计几乎不可能破裂。 3 搭配可保护内部显示屏的新型无齿轮铰链和由超强陶瓷盖玻璃制成的新型 Super Actua 外部显示屏，这款手机的耐用性是去年设备的三倍，也是我们迄今为止最耐用的 Pixel Fold。 4

此外，得益于新铰链更大的弯曲半径和内部显示屏上更厚的玻璃层，Pixel 11 Pro Fold 还改善了折痕性能。 两款显示屏的亮度都比去年提高了 20%，达到 3600 尼特。 5

您会注意到，我们还升级了 Pixel 11 Pro Fold 的充电速度。 插入电源，使用 30W 有线充电，约 30 分钟即可充电 50%。 6 无线充电速度比我们上一代 Fold 手机快 20%，内置高达 25W Qi2.2。 7 除了充电之外，Pixel 11 Pro Fold 的电池续航时间超过 24 小时，让您可以自信地度过一天。 8

大屏幕新功能

Pixel 11 Pro Fold 由我们全新定制的 Tensor G6 芯片提供支持，并配备 16GB RAM，可提供流畅、快速的性能，专为 Gemini Intelligence 设计。 9

Pixel 11 Pro Fold 上的双屏幕非常适合实时翻译，尤其是我们新的手语到文本功能。 它是与聋人社区合作开发的，可让手语者在 Live Transcribe 和 Gboard 中用母语表达自己的意思。 10 Pixel 11 Pro Fold 的免提外形使签名设置变得简单，并且可以用于单手和双手签名。 将美国手语发送到前置摄像头，翻译将显示在外部显示屏上。

气泡已针对 Fold 进行了优化，使多任务处理变得容易。 将任何应用程序变成气泡，展开后您就可以在屏幕右下角看到它，以便快速轻松地访问。

您熟悉和喜爱的可折叠独有功能将继续存在，例如拖放、分屏、即时视图以及“Made You Look”的两个新动画。 此外，Pixel 11 Pro Fold 配备了与 Pixel 11 系列其他产品相同的有用功能，包括主动协助 11 以及改进的 Circle to Search 与 Pixel Camera 的集成。 12
